---
title: "Stappen vs Hartslag — Analyse"
author: "Mohammed"
output: html_document
---


## 1. Libraries laden

```{r libraries}
if (!require(ggplot2)) install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
```

---

## 2. Data inladen

```{r data-laden}
data <- read.csv("C:/Users/Lucas/Downloads/combined_data_mohammed.csv")
```

---

## 3. Data voorbereiden

```{r data-prep}
data$date <- as.Date(data$date)
data <- data[complete.cases(data), ]

cat("Data punten: n =", nrow(data), "\n")
```

---

## 4. Statistieken

```{r statistieken}
cat("Gemiddelde hartslag — Mean:", round(mean(data$average_heart_rate), 2),
    ", SD:", round(sd(data$average_heart_rate), 2), "\n")

cat("Stappen per dag     — Mean:", round(mean(data$total_steps), 2),
    ", SD:", round(sd(data$total_steps), 2), "\n")
```

---

## 5. Analyse A — Stappen vs Gemiddelde Hartslag

### Correlatie

```{r correlatie-hartslag}
model_hr <- lm(average_heart_rate ~ total_steps, data = data)
sum_hr   <- summary(model_hr)
corr     <- cor.test(data$total_steps, data$average_heart_rate, alternative = "two.sided")
cat("R^2 =", round(sum_hr$r.squared, 3), ", p (cor.test) =", round(corr$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

### Plot

```{r plot-hartslag, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ggplot(data, aes(x = total_steps, y = average_heart_rate)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Stappen vs Gemiddelde Hartslag",
    x     = "Stappen per dag",
    y     = "Gemiddelde Hartslag (bpm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

---

## 8. Tijdlijn — Stappen & Hartslag per dag

```{r tijdlijn, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
scale_factor <- max(data$total_steps) / max(data$average_heart_rate)

ggplot(data, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = total_steps / scale_factor), stat = "identity",
           fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = average_heart_rate), color = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = average_heart_rate), color = "red", size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name     = "Gemiddelde Hartslag (bpm)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * scale_factor, name = "Stappen per dag")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Stappen & Hartslag per dag", x = "Datum") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = "red"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "steelblue")
  )
```
